Steps 1-4 of the chartered chain are limitGuardAbove_of_priorU, whose hypotheses are FrameClass.Dedekind <= fc plus UNRESTRICTED Until coherence in both directions; restricted-at-root coherence cannot supply it, since the lemma applies Prior-U at psi, top and (neg psi or kPlus neg psi), none of which lie in subformulaClosure root. Step 5 is Statement 1, transcribed verbatim per the plan's explicit TRANSCRIBE-do-not-re-derive instruction, and it consumes limitGuardBelow_of_priorS directly, hence hfc/hSf/hSb; h_lgb is that lemma's packaged conclusion and cannot substitute for its ingredients without re-deriving Statement 1 at the bundle level.
